target.statement: Average per-snapshot AUC of the trained AddGraph baseline (and X-AddGraph, identical by construction) on UCI Message = 0.8705
target.dataset: UCI Message (Opsahl & Panzarasa online student community, 1,899 nodes, 59,835 edges)

compute.basis: Small graph (~60k edges, 1,899 nodes, hidden dim 100, window 2) trained 35 epochs; the paper reports 10.1 s/edge explanation on a T4, so training plus a handful of snapshot evaluations fits comfortably on CPU in a couple of hours, but the exact 0.8705 depends on the stochastic anomaly-injection seeding and the released code's fidelity.

blockers: Exact AUC 0.8705 depends on re-seeded anomaly injection and hyperparameter details; the paper itself reports a slightly different explainer-side AUC (0.8491), so bit-exact reproduction of 0.8705 is uncertain
Released repo may not include the exact training config/seeds used for the reported number
title: Dual Spatial-Temporal Attribution: Architecture-Aligned Post-Hoc Explainability for Recurrent Graph Anomaly Detection
